The patch was submitted successfully. I will now provide the final summary.

The title of the `Panel` was missing the panel background style because the style derived from `self.style` was not being applied to the title text before rendering. I fixed this by explicitly applying `console.get_style(self.style)` to `title_text` within `rich/panel.py`, ensuring the panel's background style is present on the title.
